items.title: Q3 Earnings Scorecard: Solid Beats, Upward Revisions, and AI Drivers
items.summary: Roughly 75% of S&P 500 members have reported results in the Q3 cycle, with earnings up +24.8% from the same period last year on +14.0% higher revenues. The Tech sector remains a strong contributor, as earnings for the sector are on pace to grow +44.2% year-over-year on +35.0% higher revenues.
